Semantic authoring [exomem.semantic-authoring:v9 sha256:a6978ee9249f3c3fac17339b9b92dc18be3c82e1206441725f6c2a750d984090]: Choose homes by future use and accumulated content, not mentions or broad scope. Keep coherent long notes; reuse or create a home for independent material. Live compiled creates, replacements and transitions to live need a valid nonempty semantic unit; pending pages may remain unit-free. A post-activation compliant page cannot lose its final valid semantic unit. Inspect affected claims and evidence. Distinguish attributed accounts from established facts. Correct suitable existing units with guarded writers, justified verdicts and exact links; verify current state. Refutation alone changes neither lifecycle nor rank. Writers retain prior interpretations; request bootstrap with profile=full for history guidance. Compact: `## Observations` then `- [category] content #tags (context) ^anchor`; one open category. Rich: `## <Governed Kind>`. Choose exactly one primary category: prefer a meaningful epistemic or operational role and put the domain in tags, but if the role would only be a generic fact, finding, or observation and the domain is the durable lens, use a domain category instead. Role example: - [decision] Relocate to a coastal city next spring #life ^relocation `missing_semantic_unit`: Add `## Observations` and `- [operating constraint] Keep retries bounded #reliability`. `empty_rich_unit`: Add substantive body content or remove the empty recognized heading. Keys/examples: call bootstrap with operation.kind="instructions", profile="full".
